Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:10:1.english: The older [daughters] - The daughters of the first [wife].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:10:2.english: The younger ones - The daughters of the second [wife].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:10:3.hebrew: אם קטנה שבגדולות - וכ"ש אמצעית שבגדולות בספק זה, ולגבי בנות שניה מקרי כולהו בנות גדולות:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:10:3.english: If the youngest of the older [group] - And all the more so is the middle [daughter] of the older [group] in this doubt; and relative to the daughters of the second [wife], all of them are called "older daughters."

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:10:4.hebrew: כולן אסורות - לאחרים, עד שיתן גט. ואפי' אמצעית שבקטנות, דלגבי קטנות אותה הבת גדולה היא. ושמעינן: דהמקדש אחת משתי אחיות סתם — שתיהן צריכות גט:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:10:4.english: All of them are forbidden - To others, until he gives a bill of divorce. And even the middle [daughter] of the younger [group], because relative to the younger [daughters], that daughter is an elder. And we learn [from this] that one who betroths one of two sisters without specifying — both of them require a bill of divorce.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:11:1.english: Where they were identified - At the time of betrothal, he specified to him [which daughter it was].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:11:2.english: And later they became intermingled - He forgot which elder [daughter] he had specified to him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:12:1.hebrew: לאפוקי מדר' יוסי - דפליג באידך פירקא (לקמן קידושין דף סד:), ואמר: כולן מותרות להנשא לאחרים בלא גט, חוץ מן הגדולה שבגדולות:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:12:1.english: To exclude [the opinion] of Rabbi Yosei - For he disagrees in the other chapter (below, Kiddushin 64b) and says: All of them are permitted to marry others without a bill of divorce, except for the eldest of the older [daughters].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:12:2.hebrew: דלא מחית איניש נפשיה לספיקא - להזכיר שם גדולה, אם לא גדולה שבכולן, שאם ישתכח הדבר — שלא יהא בספק:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:12:2.english: That a person does not place himself into [a situation of] uncertainty - [He would not] mention the designation “eldest” unless [she is] the eldest of them all, so that if the matter is forgotten, it will not be in doubt.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:14:1.hebrew: אין מוציאין אותם מידם - אפי' לא כנס הראשון את יבמתו ופגע באחות זקוקתו — מאחר שכנסה השני, פקע זיקה והותרה לראשון לקיימה; דאחות זקוקה דרבנן היא, ולא קנסי ליה להוציא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:14:1.english: They do not remove them from their possession - Even if the first [brother] did not marry his [actual] yevama and [thus] encountered [the prohibition of] the sister of his zekuka, since the second [brother] married her, the levirate bond lapsed, and she became permitted to the first to maintain [her]; for [the prohibition of] the sister of a zekuka is rabbinic, and they do not penalize him [by requiring him] to divorce [her].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:16:1.english: It is not known - Implies [that it was] never [known].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:17:1.hebrew: סיפא איצטריכא ליה - דקתני: היו שנים, אחד חולץ ואחד מייבם. ולאשמועינן דוקא הכי: מיחלץ חד מינייהו לחדא ברישא, והדר מייבם שני לשניה, ממה נפשך: אם זו ארוסת אחיו — שפיר מייבם, ואם לאו — נכרית בעלמא היא, ואינה אחות יבמתו הזקוקה לו דתיהוי דמיא לאחות אשתו, שהרי נפטרה זיקת אחותה הימנה בחליצת אחיו, ולא גזרו על אחות חלוצה משחלצה אלא על החלוץ לבדו. דקא פגע באחות זקוקה — וכל זמן שלא חלץ א' מן האחין, אסורה אחותה על כולן מדבריהם, משום דדמיא לאחות אשתו. הכי גרסינן: דיקא נמי דקתני ״ואין יודע״, ולא קתני ״ואין ידוע״:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:17:1.english: It was necessary [to teach] the latter clause - As it teaches: [If] there were two [brothers], one performs ḥalitza and one performs levirate marriage. And [this comes] to teach us that [it may be done] specifically like this: one of them performs ḥalitza with one [sister] first, and then the second [brother] performs levirate marriage with the second [sister] — whichever way you look at it: if this [second sister] is his brother's betrothed, he is properly performing levirate marriage; and if not, she is merely an unrelated woman, and is not the sister of his yevama who is bound to him so that she would resemble a wife's sister, for the levirate bond of her sister was released from her by his brother's ḥalitza, and they did not decree against the sister of a ḥalutza once she has performed ḥalitza except upon the one who performed ḥalitza alone. [For if he were to perform levirate marriage first,] he would be encountering the sister of a woman bound [by the levirate bond]; and as long as one of the brothers has not performed ḥalitza, her sister is forbidden to all of them by rabbinic law because she resembles a wife's sister. This is the correct text: “The language is also precise, as it teaches: ‘And he does not know,’ and it does not teach: ‘And it is not known.’”

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:1:1.hebrew: אלא לאו אחת מכם - דלאו ״את וחמור״ הוא, דאם קידש זו לא קידש זו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:1:1.english: Rather, is it not "One of you" - For it is not [a case of] "you and a donkey," since if he betrothed this one, he did not betroth that one.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:1:2.hebrew: רבא מתרץ - מתני' לטעמיה: הא דקתני "כאחת", לאו למידק "הא אחת מאשה ובתה מקודשת", אלא ה"ק: המקדש אחת מאשה ובתה, הרי הוא כמו שקדשן כאחת, ואינן מקודשות — דקידושין שאין מסורין לביאה הן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:1:2.english: Rava explains - [He explains] the Mishnah according to his line of reasoning: That which [the Mishnah] teaches, "at once," is not to infer: "Behold, [if he betrothed] one of a woman and her daughter, she is betrothed"; rather, this is what it is saying: One who betroths one of a woman and her daughter, it is as though he betrothed them at once, and they are not betrothed, for it is a betrothal that is not given to consummation.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:4:1.hebrew: הרי כולכם ואחת משתי אחיות כו' - דהשתא לאו את וחמור הוא; דהא דאין אחיות מקודשות — משום ספיקא הוא, דלא ידע הי קדיש, הא אי ידע — בת זכייה היא, הלכך נכריות מקודשות. והא דלא אוקמא כגון דאמר אחת מכם — משום דקתני במתני' כלכם, ואין לשבש הספרים ולומר דאחת מכלכם גרס, וכגון שלא קידש אלא חדא; דא"כ, לא מתרצא הא דאשמועינן לקמן (קידושין דף נב.) ממתני': אשה נעשית שליח לחברתה במקום שנעשית לה צרה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:4:1.english: “All of you, and one of the two sisters, etc.” - For now, this is not [a case of] “you and a donkey” [where an acquisition attempted for an eligible party alongside an entity incapable of acquisition fails], for the fact that the sisters are not betrothed is [only] due to uncertainty, since it is not known which [of them] he betrothed; whereas if it were known, she would be capable of acquisition. Therefore, the unrelated women are betrothed. And as for the fact that [Rava] did not establish [the mishna's case] as being where he said “one of you,” it is because the mishna teaches: “All of you”; and one should not corrupt the books to say that it reads “one of all of you,” and [that it was] a case where he betrothed only one [woman], for if so, that which [the Gemara] teaches us below (Kiddushin 52a) from our mishna — [namely, that] “a woman can become an agent for her fellow [woman to accept betrothal] in a situation where she becomes a rival wife to her” — could not be sustained.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:5:1.english: One who betroths his daughter without specification - [Where a man said to him,] “One of your daughters is betrothed to me.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:5:2.hebrew: אין הבוגרות בכלל - אם יש בוגרות הרבה, אין אחת מהן בספק קידושין הללו להצטרך גט, לפי שאינן ברשותו לקבל להו קידושין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:5:2.english: The grown women are not included - If there are multiple grown [daughters], not one of them is in doubt concerning this betrothal so as to require a bill of divorce, because they are not under his authority to accept betrothal for them.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:5:3.hebrew: הא קטנות בכלל - וצריכות גט, ואפי' הרבה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:5:3.english: This implies that minor daughters are included - And they require a bill of divorce, and even [if there are] many.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:6:1.hebrew: כשאין שם אלא בוגרת אחת וקטנה אחת - וכיון שאין הגדולה בספק, אין קידושין אלא בקטנה, וקידושי ודאי הן. וה"ה אם היו שם גדולות הרבה — כיון דאינן בכלל, הוו להו קידושין בקטנה. ולהכי איצטריך לשנויי כשאין שם אלא גדולה אחת — דעל כרחך קטנו' דומיא דגדולות דייקינן, ומהשתא דייק הכי: הא קטנה בכלל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:6:1.english: When there is only one adult [daughter] and one minor [daughter] - And since the adult [daughter] is not in doubt, the betrothal is only upon the minor [daughter], and it is a definite betrothal. And the same law would apply if there were many adult [daughters] there — since they are not included, the betrothal would be upon the minor [daughter]. And for this reason [Rava] needed to answer “when there is only one adult [daughter]” — because perforce we infer minor [daughters] corresponding to adult [daughters]; and now, one infers thus: “Rather, the minor [daughter is] included.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:7:1.hebrew: והא בוגרות קתני - טובא, ודכוותה דייקינן על כרחיך: הא קטנות בכלל, ודאיכא תרתי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:7:1.english: But it teaches grown women - [Meaning] multiple [grown daughters]; and corresponding to it, we perforce infer: Minor daughters are included, and [that] there are two [minor daughters].

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:7:2.hebrew: בוגרות דעלמא - כל איש שיש לו בת בוגרת, אין אותן הבוגרות בכלל קידושין שקבל אביה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:7:2.english: Grown women in general - [For] any man who has a grown daughter, those grown women are not included in the betrothal that her father accepted.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:7:3.hebrew: אי הכי מאי למימרא - אי אמרת בשלמא בדאיכא טובא, איצטריך למתני משום דיוקא דידה, למידק: הא קטנות בכלל — לאשמועי' דקידושין שאין מסורין לביאה הוי קידושין. אלא השתא, לא איהו איצטריך ולא דיוקא דידה איצטריך; דפשיטא דבבוגרת אין לו רשות, ואין כאן עוד אלא קטנה, וקידושין מסורין לביאה הן, ופשיטא דהוו קידושין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:7:3.english: If so, what is [the purpose of] stating [this] - Granted, if you say that [it is a case] where there are many [daughters], it was necessary to teach [this] because of its inference, to infer: minor daughters are included — to teach us that a betrothal that cannot lead to marital relations is a [valid] betrothal. But now, neither it [the explicit statement] was needed nor was its inference needed; for it is obvious that he has no authority over an adult daughter, and there is no [daughter] here other than a minor [daughter], and [thus] it is a betrothal that can lead to marital relations, and it is obvious that it is a [valid] betrothal.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:8:1.english: Where she designated him an agent - To betroth her to anyone who comes.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:8:2.english: From which he has benefit - For her betrothal money is his.

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:9:1.hebrew: מי לא עסקינן - קושיא היא: וכי לא שמעינן מינה ממתני', דאפי' אמרה לאביה "קידושיי לדידך", קתני נמי דאינה בכלל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:9:1.english: Aren’t we dealing - This is a difficulty: Do we not infer from it, from the Mishnah, that even [if] she said to her father, “My betrothal [money] is for you,” it also teaches that she is not included?

Rashi on Kiddushin 51b:9:2.english: That is incumbent upon him - As it is written (Jeremiah 29:6): “And give your daughters to men.”
